id.description: Unique identifier for the compliance document. Use as the {id} path parameter to show, update, or delete this document via the .../compliance_documents/{id} endpoints.

name.description: Display name of the compliance document.

notes.description: Free-text notes describing the compliance document.

type.description: Category of compliance document (for example bond, license, permit, safety, or w9).

status.description: Compliance status of the document. Automatically returned as not_compliant once expires_at is in the past, regardless of the stored value.

effective_at.description: Timestamp when the document becomes effective, in ISO 8601 format. Null if no effective date is set.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the document expires, in ISO 8601 format. After this time the document is treated as not compliant. Null if the document does not expire.

send_expiration_notification.description: Whether expiration reminder notifications are sent for this document.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the document was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the document was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

attachments.description: the files attached to this document

content_type.description: the content type of the file

url.description: a signed URL to load the file
